7.2.24.9 State operation to do in: S_CC_STARTED
[SWS_CanSM_00532] Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01145, SRS_Can_01142
⌈As long the sub state machine CANSM_BSM_S_CHANGE_BAUDRATE is in the state S_CC_STARTED, the CanSM module shall operate the do action DO_SET_CC_MODE_STARTED and therefore repeat for all configured CAN controllers of the CAN network (ref. to [ECUC_CanSM_00141]) the API request CanIf_SetControllerMode (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_91002]) with ControllerMode equal to CAN_CS_STARTED, if the current CAN controller mode (ref. to [SWS_CanSM_00638]) is different.⌋
